note: Wide target batching (64/256/1024 synchronized walks) for prime-field IC against the incumbent walk, same binary, sessions, targets and rounds. A wall-time study: counted S cannot fall with width. The schema's `ic` band slot carries the 16-lane arm, the best width; the matched rho reference is the session's own rho.negation arm.

rho_reference.binary_or_process: ecbench release build of this branch; every arm of a session runs in that session's binary
rho_reference.protocol: each spec's rho.negation reference arm (role reference), run in every session on the same curve, targets and rounds as the candidate arms; prime-order curves (A = 2), so negation is the strongest symmetry available
